How it works

Three steps.

  1. Describe the project

    What the client needs, plus services, budget range and timeline if you know them.

  2. Review the proposal

    Check every line item and price — you know your rates best.

  3. Send it

    Download it as a PDF and send it to your client.

ⓘ Check the numbers. Prices are suggested from the budget you enter. Review every line item before you send it — the quote goes out under your name.

FAQ

Common questions.

Will it know my prices?
Only what you tell it. Enter a budget range and the services you offer, then adjust any line item to your real rates before sending.
Can I add my business name and logo?
Your business name and contact details from your business profile are filled in for you. Logos aren't supported yet.
Is what I enter stored?
No. What you enter is used to write your result and isn't kept afterward. The only things Workblox Business saves are your business profile and, if you use it, your Contacts list. See the Privacy Policy.
What does it cost?
Proposal Generator is part of Workblox Business. You pick your tools and pay by how many: $25/mo for 1–3 tools, $40/mo for 4–7 tools, or $75/mo for 8–16 tools, with a 7-day free trial.
